item.title: German Chancellor Merz arrives in China for talks on trade, security
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz touched down in China on Wednesday, beginning his inaugural visit to his country’s largest trade partner and a high-tech rival as Europe’s biggest economy struggles. item.title: Budget 2026: Hong Kong gov’t to earmark HK$4 billion to buy out fire-hit Wang Fuk Court flats
item.description: The Hong Kong government will set aside HK$4 billion to buy out the fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court flats in Tai Po, the city’s finance chief has said. Financial Secretary Paul Chan announced the plan during the 2026 budget speech on Wednesday, days after the government unveiled its buyout plan. item.title: Budget 2026: Hong Kong taxpayers, businesses to get maximum HK$3,000 salaries, profits tax cuts
item.description: Hong Kong residents will receive a maximum HK$3,000 reduction in salaries tax for the 2025-26 assessment year – double the previous cut – finance chief Paul Chan has said during his annual budget speech. In addition, businesses will get up to HK$3,000 profits tax reduction in 2025-26, Chan also said on Wednesday. Both salaries and […]

item.title: Budget 2026: More relief packages for taxpayers, from basic to child allowances
item.description: Hong Kong taxpayers will receive increased tax allowances, including the child allowance, starting in the 2026-27 fiscal year, the city’s finance minister has said. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said during his annual budget speech on Wednesday that the basic allowance and the single parent allowance would each rise by nearly 10 per cent, from HK$132,000 […]

item.title: Chinese drone maker DJI sues to challenge US import ban
item.description: Chinese firm DJI, the world’s largest drone manufacturer, has sued the US Federal Communications Commission for adding it to a blacklist which restricts sales in the United States, the company said Wednesday. item.description: Hong Kong lawmakers have heaped praise on the annual budget address, particularly the focus on promoting artificial intelligence (AI) and funding for Northern Metropolis projects. item.title: Hong Kong court quashes Jimmy Lai’s fraud conviction over Apple Daily HQ lease violation
item.description: A Hong Kong appeals court has overturned pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai‘s fraud conviction relating to an alleged lease violation at the now-shuttered Apple Daily newspaper headquarters. His jail term stemming from the case was quashed, though Lai still remains behind bars, serving 20 years in jail under a separate national security conviction. The Court […]

item.description: The father of a wanted Hong Kong activist has been jailed for 8 months after he sought to cancel an insurance policy linked to an “absconder.” Kwok Yin-sang appeared at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday morning to receive his sentence, after being found guilty earlier in February of attempting to obtain funds last year […]

item.title: Budget 2026: NGOs criticise lack of climate adaptation initiatives and support for low-income residents
item.description: International NGO Greenpeace has criticised the 2026 Hong Kong budget for lacking “people-centred climate initiatives,” as the city battles extreme weather. Meanwhile, the Society for Community Organisation (SoCO) has urged more support for low-income families.
